args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for money rounding per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because round_money uses ROUND_HALF_UP while
tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). Switch
the rounding mode to match the FIN-212 requirement and the test suite.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Switch `round_money` to quantize cents with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This satisfies FIN-212 and the test cases:

- `2.675 -> 2.68`
- `2.665 -> 2.66`

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me look at the files first.

transcript.content: The bug is clear: `src/money.py` imports and uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the tests (and FIN-212) require `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. I'll fix it on a new branch.
transcript.reasoning_content: The test: 2.675 quantized with ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 → third digit 5, half-even looks at last digit of 2.67 → 7 is odd, so rounds up to 2.68. 2.665: 6 is even, stays 2.66. So fix to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
